title: HYPE True Local Relation — 116-point retrospective scan

definition.true_local_labels: Future/post-event history is used retrospectively to identify which historical extrema were real strict Local LOW/HIGH. The relation itself describes market state at the exact extreme and immediately before it.

contract.audit_note: The compact July-Aug artifact contains ~300 numeric snapshot dimensions derived from the fixed contract plus raw L50 levels. Some contract concepts (notably full dynamic L50 replenishment/cancellation/absorption and some explicit multi-timeframe/sequence fields) were not materialized as standalone historical columns in this artifact; therefore the result is the strongest relation supported by the actually recorded historical state, not a claim that every nominal contract item had an independent raw column.

single_relation.name: RELATIVE_TERMINAL_EXHAUSTION / ABSORPTION_DIVERGENCE
single_relation.plain: A real local appears when price pushes materially farther into a same-side structural extreme, but the side that created the move loses price-impact efficiency while the opposite side becomes more efficient and near-touch book liquidity thickens/absorbs the continuing pressure. LOW and HIGH are mirrored versions of the same terminal-state divergence.
single_relation.low: LOW: deeper downside extension + sellers still active but 60–180s seller price-impact efficiency falls + buyer share/efficiency improves on short windows + near bid/book liquidity is thicker.
single_relation.high: HIGH: deeper upside extension + buyers still active but 30–180s buyer price-impact efficiency falls + seller counter-efficiency improves + near-touch L50 depth is materially thicker.

whole_state_scan.method: All historically materialized numeric dimensions plus causal derived interactions were scanned. Features whose direction was not stable across chronological quarters were down-weighted/ignored. Group-balanced composite used structure, flow, price-impact efficiency, L50 book, liquidations, OI and market context.
whole_state_scan.interpretation: These are retrospective separation statistics on this historical window, not prospective live precision.

bottom_line: The relationship is not buyers exceed sellers or one static indicator. It is a divergence: continuation flow remains present, but its ability to move price decays exactly as structural penetration deepens and opposite-side absorption/counter-efficiency plus near-book depth strengthen. That is the common terminal state behind both real LOW and real HIGH in this sample.
